foundation:
# Foundations of the project {name}

Filled in by the PO during framing. The ShipItRight plugin ships no foundation: the stack and the
design system are the human's own (a source of theirs: folder, git repository, MCP, skill, URL), or
created in the project (stack by the architect in P3, design system by UX in P2). Each foundation has
its manifest in `.team/foundations/<type>/<name>/foundation.md`. Format: `team/conventions/foundation.md` in the plugin.

| Stack | to declare during framing | | |

## ShipItRight

Project built by the ShipItRight agent team (see `PROCESS.md` in the ShipItRight plugin).

- Deliverables: open `docs/index.html` in a browser.
- Prototype: `prototype/index.html`.
- Board: `.team/board/` (source of truth), Notion mirror in `.team/notion.md` if it exists.
- Foundations (stack, design system): `.team/foundation.md`.
